state:
**Goal `tooling-overhaul`: Stages 9 and 10 are done, and Stage 11 is in progress.** The cutover is on `main`. `main` stays frozen, and tag `pre-overhaul` is the rollback.

`bun nv render --website` writes all of the website's generated data. `website-rules` writes the rulebook. `website-core` (`tools/nv/renderers/website-core.ts`) writes `website/src/data/core.json` and the Core stub pages. It reads the member tables from the `spec_core_members` record and the class prose (summary, `Enums:`, `Constants:`, bullet rosters, headings) from `docs/spec/01-core-library.md`. It reads the registry from `nvs meta --json`, with no Rust text scan, and the corrections from `website/config/spec-overrides.mjs`. It needs a built binary, so it is in `WEBSITE_RENDERERS` only, not in the `RENDERERS` that CI's docs job checks. A draft page is the renderer's, and `Owned.mine` in `tools/nv/lib/render.ts` makes only a draft page an orphan. `website/scripts/sync-core.mjs` and `website/scripts/lib/` are deleted.

The Stage 11 check `CI, the website and the git hooks run bun…` passes: `bun nv audit ci` prints both of its `want` lines. The other Stage 11 check, `bun nv loop-stats --guard`, is still red. This is an open item, not a regression: `loop-stats` is not ported yet.
